items.name: utils
items.description: cn() class-name merge helper used by every component in the registry.

items.name: button
items.description: Button with 9 variants (primary/secondary/accent/glow/soft/outline/ghost/link/destructive) and 8 sizes (xs-xl plus 3 icon sizes) via class-variance-authority, left/right icon slots, a non-reflowing loading state, and asChild composition via Radix Slot.

items.name: card
items.description: Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter.

items.name: badge
items.description: Badge with variant props via class-variance-authority.

items.name: input
items.description: Styled text input wrapping the native <input> element.

items.name: label
items.description: Label built on Radix Label. Used standalone or as the labeling piece of Form.

items.name: form
items.description: Form, FormField, FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl, FormDescription, FormMessage -- built on react-hook-form's FormProvider + Controller + useFormContext, with Radix Slot wiring FormControl to whatever input it wraps. Resolver-agnostic: works with zodResolver (recommended), valibot, or a hand-rolled resolver passed to your own useForm() call.

items.name: command
items.description: A ⌘K command palette (Command, CommandDialog, CommandInput, CommandList, CommandGroup, CommandItem, CommandShortcut) built on cmdk, with its own dialog chrome so it doesn't require a separate Dialog primitive.

items.name: textarea
items.description: Styled multi-line text input wrapping the native <textarea> element.

items.name: switch
items.description: Toggle switch built on Radix Switch, with a thumb that stays legible against both checked and unchecked track colors in either theme.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: Tooltip, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent built on Radix Tooltip.

items.name: tabs
items.description: Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent built on Radix Tabs, styled as a pill-segmented control.

items.name: select
items.description: Select, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectValue, SelectGroup built on Radix Select.

items.name: dialog
items.description: Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogFooter, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogClose built on Radix Dialog.

items.name: alert
items.description: Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription with default/destructive variants via class-variance-authority.

items.name: avatar
items.description: Avatar, AvatarImage, AvatarFallback built on Radix Avatar.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: Checkbox built on Radix Checkbox.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem built on Radix Radio Group.

items.name: separator
items.description: Separator (horizontal or vertical divider) built on Radix Separator.

items.name: progress
items.description: Progress bar built on Radix Progress.

items.name: accordion
items.description: Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent built on Radix Accordion. Requires --ease-fluid plus two keyframes in your global CSS for the expand/collapse animation and the trigger icon rotation (accordion-down/accordion-up, animating to/from Radix's --radix-accordion-content-height) — dsgn add does not inject these; without them the ease-fluid/animate-accordion-* utility classes compile to nothing and the accordion snaps open with no animation. See design.dhruvchoudhary.com's own apps/site/app/globals.css for the exact --ease-fluid value, the two --animate-accordion-* lines, and the two @keyframes blocks to copy — or skills/dsgn/reference/component-registry.md's Accordion entry for the same snippet inline.

items.name: popover
items.description: Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent, PopoverAnchor built on Radix Popover.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuShortcut built on Radix Dropdown Menu.

items.name: table
items.description: Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption -- styled native <table> elements, no primitive dependency.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: A pulsing placeholder for content that hasn't loaded yet.

items.name: empty-state
items.description: The "no rows yet" / "no results" state -- a dashed placeholder with an icon, title, description, and optional action.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.description: Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator, BreadcrumbEllipsis -- plain semantic nav/ol markup, no primitive library dependency. BreadcrumbLink's hover transition uses --ease-fluid; without it in your global CSS the ease-fluid utility compiles to nothing and the transition silently falls back to the browser default easing (a minor visual difference, not a broken build) -- see the Accordion entry for the exact value.

items.name: pagination
items.description: Pagination, PaginationContent, PaginationItem, PaginationLink, PaginationPrevious, PaginationNext, PaginationEllipsis -- built on Button's own variants, no primitive library dependency.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: AlertDialog, AlertDialogTrigger, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel -- built on Radix Alert Dialog. Distinct from Dialog: forces an explicit confirm/cancel choice, can't be dismissed by clicking outside, for destructive actions.

items.name: sheet
items.description: Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetContent (side: top/right/bottom/left), SheetHeader, SheetFooter, SheetTitle, SheetDescription -- built on Radix Dialog (no new primitive dependency), edge-anchored instead of centered.

items.name: combobox
items.description: Combobox -- a searchable select, composed from Popover + Command + Button (no new primitive dependency). Controlled: options/value/onValueChange.

items.name: toast
items.description: Toast, ToastProvider, ToastViewport, ToastTitle, ToastDescription, ToastClose, ToastAction (toast.tsx) + an imperative toast() API (use-toast.ts) + a <Toaster /> to mount once near the app root (toaster.tsx). Built on Radix Toast.

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem -- a segmented control, built on Radix Toggle Group. type="single" or "multiple" selection.

items.name: slider
items.description: Slider -- built on Radix Slider. One Thumb per value in the value/defaultValue array, so the same component covers both single-handle and range sliders.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: Collapsible, CollapsibleTrigger, CollapsibleContent -- a single show/hide section, built on Radix Collapsible. Distinct from accordion, which manages multiple items.

items.name: toggle
items.description: Toggle -- a single pressed/unpressed button, built on Radix Toggle. The singular sibling of toggle-group.

items.name: hover-card
items.description: HoverCard, HoverCardTrigger, HoverCardContent -- a hover-triggered preview panel, built on Radix Hover Card.

items.name: scroll-area
items.description: ScrollArea, ScrollBar -- custom-styled scrollbars for a fixed-height panel, built on Radix Scroll Area.

items.name: context-menu
items.description: ContextMenu and sub-parts -- a right-click menu, built on Radix Context Menu. Same shape as dropdown-menu.

items.name: calendar
items.description: Calendar -- built on react-day-picker v10, styled to dsgn's border/radius/token conventions (border-border, bg-accent, text-accent-foreground, bg-muted). Supports single/range/multiple selection modes via react-day-picker's own props.

items.name: date-picker
items.description: DatePicker -- a single-date picker composed from Popover + Button + Calendar (no new primitive dependency). Controlled: value/onValueChange.

items.name: data-table
items.description: DataTable -- a sortable, filterable, paginated table composed from Table + Button + Input and @tanstack/react-table (v8 line -- see the in-file note on why, next to its ColumnDef-based ColumnDef/columns+data API). Generic over columns/data via TanStack's ColumnDef, not tied to any specific dataset shape.

items.name: drawer
items.description: Drawer, DrawerTrigger, DrawerContent, DrawerHeader, DrawerFooter, DrawerTitle, DrawerDescription, DrawerClose -- a bottom-sheet with real drag-to-dismiss gesture behavior, built on vaul. Distinct from Sheet, which is Radix Dialog repositioned to an edge with no gesture support.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.description: NavigationMenu and sub-parts -- a top-level site nav with flyout panels, built on Radix Navigation Menu, styled consistently with dropdown-menu/context-menu.

items.name: menubar
items.description: Menubar and sub-parts -- a desktop-app-style top menu bar, built on Radix Menubar. Same compound shape as dropdown-menu/context-menu.

items.name: multi-select
items.description: MultiSelect -- a tags-input style multi-value select, composed from Popover + Command + Badge + Button (no new primitive dependency). Controlled: options/value/onValueChange.

items.name: carousel
items.description: Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselPrevious, CarouselNext -- built on embla-carousel-react, with prev/next controls composed from Button (no new primitive-library dependency for the arrows). Keyboard arrow-key navigation built in.

items.name: resizable
items.description: ResizablePanelGroup, ResizablePanel, ResizableHandle -- built on react-resizable-panels 4.x (see the in-file note on its renamed Group/Panel/Separator API vs. the PanelGroup/Panel/PanelResizeHandle shape most docs still reference). ResizableHandle takes an optional withHandle prop for a visible grip.

items.name: input-otp
items.description: InputOTP, InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSlot, InputOTPSeparator -- a one-time-passcode input built on the input-otp npm package (OTPInput + its RenderProps context), styled slot-by-slot.

items.name: kbd
items.description: Kbd -- a styled <kbd> wrapper for rendering a keyboard shortcut, no primitive-library dependency.

items.name: file-upload
items.description: FileUpload -- a drag-and-drop + click-to-browse dropzone with a per-file list and optional progress bars, composed from Button + Progress. Controlled (value/onValueChange) and presentational only: it never performs the actual upload, since transport is app-specific.

items.name: stepper
items.description: Stepper -- a numbered/checked multi-step progress indicator with per-step label/description, horizontal or vertical via an orientation prop. No primitive-library dependency.

items.name: timeline
items.description: Timeline -- a vertical timeline with dot/icon markers connected by a line, each entry taking a title/timestamp/description. No primitive-library dependency.

items.name: recipe-auth-form
items.description: Recipe -- a real sign-in form composed from Card + Input + Checkbox + Button. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:auth-form`.

items.name: recipe-settings-panel
items.description: Recipe -- a preferences panel composed from Card + Switch + Select + Separator + Button. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:settings-panel`.

items.name: recipe-pricing-tiers
items.description: Recipe -- a 3-tier pricing layout composed from Card + Badge + Button. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:pricing-tiers`.

items.name: recipe-empty-state-cta
items.description: Recipe -- a "no projects yet" panel composed from EmptyState + Button. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:empty-state-cta`.

items.name: recipe-billing-summary
items.description: Recipe -- a plan/usage summary composed from Card + Badge + Progress + Button. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:billing-summary`.

items.name: recipe-team-members
items.description: Recipe -- a team members table with per-row role badge and actions menu, composed from Table + Avatar + Badge + DropdownMenu + Button. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:team-members`.

items.name: recipe-notification-list
items.description: Recipe -- an unread-count notification feed composed from Card + Avatar + Badge. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:notification-list`.

items.name: recipe-onboarding-checklist
items.description: Recipe -- a step checklist with progress, composed from Card + Progress + Checkbox. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:onboarding-checklist`.

items.name: recipe-stat-tiles
items.description: Recipe -- a responsive KPI tile grid with colored trend badges, composed from Card + Badge. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:stat-tiles`.

items.name: recipe-testimonial-marquee
items.description: Recipe -- a hover-pausing auto-scrolling row of quote cards, composed from Card + Avatar with a self-contained CSS keyframe animation. Installed via `dsgn add recipe:testimonial-marquee`.

items.name: rating
items.description: Star (or configurable icon) rating -- read-only display with fractional fill via a clipped overlay, plus a controlled interactive input mode with hover-preview and arrow-key support. Interactive mode uses role="radiogroup"/"radio" (a discrete 1-N choice, not a continuous range). No new dependency -- inline SVG star icon.

items.name: color-picker
items.description: A color swatch trigger that opens a Popover containing a native <input type="color"> (real browser color-picker UI, no hand-rolled HSV wheel), a row of preset swatches, and a hex text input. Controlled: value/onValueChange.

items.name: avatar-group
items.description: A row of overlapping Avatars (negative-margin stacking, ring-background separation) with a max prop that collapses overflow into a trailing "+N" avatar-styled badge.

items.name: command-palette
items.description: CommandPaletteProvider + useCommandPalette() + CommandPalette -- a generic, reusable global ⌘K/Ctrl+K command palette wired on top of Command's own CommandDialog chrome. The provider owns open/closed state and the keyboard shortcut; CommandPalette renders the dialog from an items list.
